_comment: Repository health ratchets. Each metric states its own rule; see doc/BUILD_HEALTH.md for the authoritative table and HealthRatchetTest for enforcement. Ceilings (moduleCount, projectDependencyEdges, todoFixmeMarkers, deprecatedMarkers) fail the build when exceeded. mainSourceFiles and testSourceFiles use a ceiling and a floor respectively, and releaseApkMibPerAbi is recorded but NOT gated because measuring it needs a full release build. Timing budgets live in doc/BUILD_HEALTH.md and are measured on a schedule, not per-PR.

notes.todoFixmeMarkers: Ceiling only. Do not raise to accommodate new work; record intentional debt in doc/REBUILD_STATUS.md instead.
notes.releaseApkMibPerAbi: Track release, not debug. Debug is ~126 MiB because it is unminified and is not a shipped-payload signal.
notes.mainSourceFiles: Ceiling. The reconstruction adds contract types by design, so an exact match forced a manual edit on every legitimate addition. Judge the legacy-deletion target by this value falling over time. Raised 1217 -> 1219 on 2026-09-26 for exactly two added contract files, Workflow.kt and StartupWorkflow.kt (ARC-003). This is deliberately NOT the same as the 2432 reading rejected the same day: that was the .kilo/worktrees copy being counted, and the real tree measured exactly 1217. Every raise here must be justified by a named file, not by a measurement artifact.
notes.deprecatedMarkers: Ceiling only. Every @Deprecated is a bridge to a replacement path; removing the call site is the improvement.
